Nike Co-founder Donates $1 Billion to University of Oregon

Nike co-founder Phil Knight and his wife, Penny, have donated $1 billion to the University of Oregon. The university described the donation as the largest gift ever made to a comprehensive public university and will fund a new engineering school.
